the proposed LUT-based DPD using DLA is a good candidate for power amplifier linearizer.
DLA-based DPD with LUT is robust and efficient for linearizing high power efficient power amplifiers.
the proposed DLA based DPDs with combined LUTs and MP model are effective and efficient for power amplifier linearizing.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis on LUT-based DLA for power amplifier linearizer.
the DPD method for linearizing power amplifier, especially the DPD method based on combined LUT and MP model with DLA.
the DPD design for high power efficient PAs.

the DLA based LUT-based DPD method is more robust, more flexible, and easier to implement than the conventional ILA based DPD method.
the proposed DLA based DPD is more efficient than ILA based DPD, and the proposed LUT based DPD can reduce the computational complexity of MP based DPD.
the proposed DPDs can be applied in practical wireless communication systems.

the proposed DPDs can be used for high power efficiency PA linearization, and the influences of the number of bits and the instrument bandwidth on the predistorted signal are not negligible.
